notes.title: Name change: Paper Fire Rookie
notes.content:
On 13 August 2019, "Paperville Panic" will be undergoing a name change to "Paper Fire Rookie"

Why?

Mini-game "Paper Fire Rookie Arcade" is available at over 200 VR arcades worldwide, and people are loving it <3 
That’s why we thought we’d simplify things and rename "Paperville Panic" to "Paper Fire Rookie" in Steam.

The game build has changed to reflect title / logo / credit updates to "Paper Fire Rookie". Existing Owners and wishlisters should see the game name in your library automatically update to reflect this change.  We hope you enjoy the new name update.

- The Ultimerse team

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.1
notes.content:
Hi all,

We've just pushed an update for some neat post launch improvements.

We hope you've been enjoying Paperville Panic!

[h1]New Features/Quality of Life:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]New Achievements
    [*]Save file hats now display game completion percentage.
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]

[b]Global[/b]
[list]    [*]Reduced axe collision sounds
    [*]Scores for Apartment and Podium scenes have been rebalanced
    [*]Fixed Pause Menu physics that would cause objects to collide
    [*]Fixed Pause Menu audio, which wouldn’t pause voiceover lines
    [*]Fixed level loading bug, where the level would start with the Pause Menu loaded.
    [*]Fixed Steam overlay bug, where the game wouldn’t pause.
    [*]Fixed Pause Menu bug, where audio would trigger on the first frame
    [*]Fixed audio bug that would cut off voicelines for citizens in chaotic scenes
    [*]Improved water pistol particles
[/list]
[b]Loading Scene:[/b]
[list]    [*]Fixed occlusion bug on the load table
[/list]
[b]OpenTown:[/b][list]
    [*]Basketball court has been lowered
    [*]Basketballs have been smoothed out
    [*]Fixed a bug that caused the cinema lights to rotate incorrectly
[/list]
[b]Apartment:[/b][list]
    [*]Fixed some occlusion issues
    [*]Fixed boss tracking issues
    [*]Fixed an audio bug which had audio playing after the boss fight was completed
[/list]
[b]Podium:[/b][list]
    [*]Fixed an audio bug where voicelines would play when the player reset to checkpoint
    [*]Fixed a bug that caused some drones to drop out of the level
[/list]
[b]TownHall:[/b]    [list]
    [*]Implemented more voice lines during the final boss fight
    [*]Fixed a bug that caused scissor enemy types to not attack
[/list]
[b]EndScene:[/b][list]
    [*]Fixed an animation so the cop will walk away
[/list]

As always, if you encounter any issues please reach out to us either via email (support@ultimerse.com), the discussion forums here, or on Facebook/Twitter and we'll get in touch!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Paperville Panic Full Release Patch - V1.0!
notes.content:
[h1] Release Day![/h1] 

Paple! 🆘

Paperville Panic is here! We've left Early Access and to celebrate, we're offering you 10% off for the next week! 🚨

Playable on every major PC VR platform, now is the time to get saving! 🤙

We've been lucky to have some incredible experiences and we think we've built a great game and a lot of that is thanks to all of you. You are the reason we make games, you are the reason we love coming to work, and you are the reason Paperville Panic exists.

If you can't pick up the game right now, please know that every wishlist, every tweet, every kind word is a huge help to us. If you do purchase, please leave us a review! It makes a massive difference for an indie developer. 

We'd love for you to keep in touch using our socials so you can hear about any and all Paperville updates, as well as the future games we are creating.

Big love,

Ultimerse

🤜💦🔥📢

Website ➡️ www.papervillepanic.com
Facebook ➡️ www.facebook.com/ultimerse
Twitter ➡️ www.twitter.com/ultimerse
Mailing List ➡️ here[ultimerse.us16.list-manage.com]

You can now enter the cinema! Here, you can watch the credits for the game and explore the towns beautiful cinema

[/list] 
[b]SIGNPOST[/b]
Not sure where to find your next mission in the massive hubworld? We've added a helpful signpost to point you in the right direction.

[b]IMPROVED[/b][list]
    [*]Apartment [spoiler]fire wall has been replaced with rubble[/spoiler] 
    [*]Loading scene now displays controls
    [*]Performance improvements for entire game
    [*]Water pistol audio feedback improvements
    [*]Checkpoint placement improvements in all levels
    [*]Refined holster appearance
    [*]Citizen AI tweaks
    [*]Audio balancing on all levels
    [*]Removed weapon highlights
    [*]NPC Audio implemented
    [*]Reduced Townhall [spoiler]boss health[/spoiler]
    [*]Collision audio improved on small objects

    [*]Audio for grabbing and throwing tweaked
    [*]Visual feedback on [spoiler]BigBadBussBoss[/spoiler]

notes.title: Town Hall Level Update (Patch V0.9.2)
notes.content:
[h1]NEW[/h1] 

[b]Brand New Level![/b] 
The Mayor has invited you to dinner at the Town Hall! What an honor! 
Explore this grand new level and learn more about the town of Paperville.

You can watch the level teaser  [url=https://youtu.be/YGygb73KCbM]here[/url].

[B]New Holster[/b]
Lookin' good, sailo- er, firefighter! 
Using the trigger you can equip and unequip your weapons and tools to your holster as you choose - select your preferred side too, so if you're a Leftorium shopper, this ones for you.

 [h1]IMPROVED[/h1] 
[list]
    [*] All weapons and tools now have haptic feedback! Rumble harder than a controller mid Smash combo. 
    [*] Haptic feedback when grabbing objects! You won't believe it's not hands!
    [*] We lowered the height of the light switch because apparently not everyone is Bigfoot.
    [*] Madame Firework's fight has been shortened slightly, after we realised she changed her code to have more stage time. #Diva
    [*] Holograms have been updated to reflect consistency in colours. 
    [*] Your Axe now returns to your holster faster! 
    [*] The citizen A.I. is smarter - improved navigation and facial animations! 
[/list] 

 [h1]BUG FIXES[/h1] 
    [*] Fixed a bug in Apartment where citizens were dipping into the floor when extinguished (a la Wizard of Oz Wicked Witch).
    [*] Performance improvements.
    [*] Fixed a bug in apartment where some fireballs couldn't be extinguished when fighting the boss.
    [*] Fixed a checkpoint bug in Podium where the player respawned and then was unable to teleport.
    [*] General bug fixes.

notes.title: Demo Patch! V0.6
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

What's better than one demo?

TWO DEMOS!

We've added our PAX East exclusive demo to our demo download. If you'd like to see what PAX East was like, you can check out our recap video [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=toTbbvoikm0] here.[/url]

When playing the demo, you'll now load in with the option to select our original demo, or our new demo set in our upcoming convenience store level. (When we say Soon™, we mean [b]Soon[/b]™.)

The new demo is a little faster paced, so be prepared if you are new to VR! 

Otherwise, we've added the following:

- New loading screen for demo loader
- Visual improvements to original demo
- Performance improvements to demo 
- AI improvements to enemies
- Changes to gun mechanics 

Have fun! Paperville will be seeing a big update (maybe even with a special surprise SHHHH) soon! 

<3 Ultimerse

notes.title: Patch V 1.11
notes.content:
Hi all!

We've made some bug fixes prior to leaving for the Christmas period - if you encounter any major issues, please let us know and we'll get them sorted! We're back in office as of January 2nd, so we'll see you all soon!

CHANGES:

- Major lighting fixes across all missions.
- Save files more clear and can now be deleted.
- Trap door opens and has new animation process in Apartment mission.
- Spectator camera can now be toggled on/off for better performance.
- Major bug fixes and performance improvements in Podium Level
- Level achievements should be functioning correctly
- Gameplay tweaks to tutorial including lower required score/higher randomness
- Gun refill speed bug resolved, water now replenishes at correct speed
- Oculus controller support but still requires experimental 360 degree tracking
- Global performance and bug fixes

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes V 1.WeTried
notes.content:
Hi friends!

We updated a few things to make the demo a bit more user friendly.

- NOW IN HD COLOUR!
[We've improved the visuals to be more colour blind friendly!]

- Boss is cooler. Legit. (Hotter?) 
[The boss will now telegraph his attacks better so you shouldn't feel as though fireballs are appearing out of nowhere.]

- Water balloons are balloonier.
[Water balloons are visually more obvious, now with a bucket on the desk (if you're tall) and one on the floor (if you're short).]

- Throwing mechanics - betterer.
[No more Mr Burns style throws. Water balloons will now travel further.]

- There were a bunch of cockroaches and stuff. They're gone now.
[Minor bug fixes across the board!]

We hope the demo is even more enjoyable now.

<3 Meredith / The Paperville Team

@Ultimerse
